description:
Recent incident history for a provider (days clamped to 1-30),
    plus a separate `maintenance` list: maintenance scheduled or held in
    the window, including upcoming windows. Each item has its current
    status (investigating / identified / monitoring / resolved,
    scheduled / in_progress / completed), start and resolve times,
    duration, impact, affected components, the vendor's link and the
    Pingoru page (pingoru_url). Pass component (substring match on
    component name) to scope to one component. Slug accepts shorthand /
    typos via fuzzy fallback.
name: provider_incidents
